label: Спокойная мастерица
referenceText: Здравствуй, Люми. Я Марта. Сегодня мы отправимся к старой станции. Не бойся: я буду рядом.
sourceInstruct: A native Russian-speaking mature woman with a slightly low-pitched, velvety voice and a very light natural huskiness. Calm, capable and kind, like an experienced craftswoman who always knows what to do. Speak intimately but with a fully voiced sound, steady relaxed rhythm, understated warmth and dry good humor. Natural conversational phrasing, not a narrator. No whispering, no breathy seduction, no theatrical drama, no singing.

ownerFeedback.resolution: Owner approved marta-english-speaker-02. Use speaker-only conditioning for English; keep ICL for Russian.
